summary: Frontend-only regression test of static site https://megan-ops.preview.emergentagent.com after hero headline fix (image -> Italiana text). All requested checks pass on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844).

test_results.hero_is_real_text_not_image: PASS - h1#hero-title contains Operations, no in headline
test_results.font_family_italiana: PASS - computed font-family: 'Italiana, Georgia, serif' on both h1 and .mask-inner; font-size 168px desktop; color rgb(255,237,215)
test_results.desktop_no_overflow_1920: PASS - docWidth 1920 == winWidth 1920; h1 width 1192px, mask-inner 1016px (well inside)
test_results.no_broken_images: PASS - 6 imgs (mwm-mark.png x2, hero.jpg, icon-1/2/3.jpg) all naturalWidth > 0; no 4xx responses
test_results.on_load_reveal: PASS - body has classes 'has-cursor loaded'; .mask-inner transform is identity (revealed)
test_results.scroll_reveal: PASS - after scrolling to y=1500, 6 of 13 .reveal elements got .in-view
test_results.about_line_highlight: PASS - .about .body inline style --p updated to '1.000' on scroll
test_results.custom_cursor: PASS - .cursor-dot and .cursor-ring present, body has 'has-cursor' class
test_results.contact_and_instagram: PASS - mailto anchor and instagram link both present
test_results.console_errors: None (only benign cloudflare cdn-cgi/rum aborts, unrelated to app)

critical_code_review_comments: Two elements point to /assets/mwm-mark.png with different alt attributes (one empty, one 'My Wealth Media') - consider consolidating or ensuring intended duplication is accessible.
Hero is meaningful; other decorative icon-1/2/3.jpg have empty alt which is correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served from /app/frontend/public. Hero headline is now real text using Italiana Google Font (see index.html h1#hero-title). All animations (on-load reveal, scroll reveal, about line highlight, cursor, tilt) confirmed working. Use semantic selectors — no data-testid on this site.
